title: The Hallowing of Hope · Nienna’s Last Run
dek: A day-long spell becomes a siege. As the fortress breaks, Nienna draws the attackers through the Gate, leaving her companions to finish the Hallowing and bring life out of Gael’s poisoned earth.

facts.People: Nienna; Elenia; Gartina; Adelia; Dale; Jiangshi; Saray; Scribonia
facts.Outcome: Nienna is lost beyond the Gate; the Hallowing completes and life spreads from Hope

events: Nienna gives herself so Hope can live

body:
The defenders went to Hope expecting a long watch. Elenia, Gartina and Adelia needed to keep casting while their companions held the wasteland back. By the time a portal opened beside the tree, they had already spent hours fighting. The fortress sheltering the spell would break, Adelia would fall, and Nienna would cross the Gate so the others could finish.

The Hallowing took place on 6 September 2024, Day 187 of the Final War. Nienna died saving Hope. The work she protected continued after her farewell: the survivors held their ground until the spell completed and life burst out across the toxic earth.

The walk to Hope

Outside the Tower of Gael, the morning was silent and thick with fog. The company divided herbs, oils and other supplies among the three casters. Jiangshi had prayed at the altar for more. Dale offered what he had, admitting that he did not know what to do with it; Elenia cheerfully accepted. Gartina’s concealing magic covered the company as they set out.

Dale was still calling Scribonia “Mr.” Scribonia explained that intelligence did not make him more deserving of respect than the rest of the company. Dale conceded the spoken title, then reserved the right to think it. In the close formation, Jiangshi’s flight also meant an occasional accidental kick to a taller companion’s shins.

Hope was larger than when they had last seen it. Adelia greeted the tree with delight, then raised her magical fortress to shelter the work. Elenia and Gartina took their places, and Adelia joined them inside. Nienna asked Dale for a song to give the defenders courage. Although she admitted doubts about prayer, she also asked Adelia for one. They would take all the help they could get.

Keeping watch through the fog

Nienna took the northeast quadrant, remembering the direction of the previous main assault. Scribonia watched the southwest and sent Saturnia farther out. Saray kept a close lookout. Jiangshi and her summoned companions helped cover the fortress. The casters remained at their task while the defenders watched the fog.

The first hour passed quietly. Then dark, winged shapes appeared, with another screeching overhead. Nienna warned the others about fire and called the creatures toward her. She also told Dale to conserve the power of his strongest attacks. He agreed, though the fighting soon gave him plenty of reason to use it.

Scribonia marked a lurking enemy with a psychic bolt and directed the others toward it. Dale struck another with a surge of radiant power. When the final shadow demon broke apart, quiet returned. The defenders had time to look over a magical cloak left behind, and Saray warmly praised Dale’s fighting. Inside, Adelia settled on her bedroll and kept concentrating. Elenia encouraged the other casters. For several more hours, the plan still held.

The opening in reality

A hole tore through reality. Wraiths stood at its edge, and larger figures waited behind them. Scribonia recognized something of the place beyond from his own travels, but the opening’s full nature was not settled. The immediate danger was clear: the company now faced a route through which more enemies could reach Hope.

Scribonia placed a psychic blast in the portal. The wraiths came on with extraordinary speed. A stone wall rose between the defenders and the opening, while a ghost slipped through the fortress wall toward the tree. Nienna tried to hold the creatures breaking into the shelter and warned that the casters inside could not defend themselves.

The attackers forced the defenders to split their attention between the portal, the ghosts and the larger creatures advancing on the building. Dale could not immediately get clear. Scribonia had to slip away from enemies closing on him. Jiangshi watched one of her summoned companions fall while she fought to keep the pressure off the casters.

The wall breaks

A giant’s cry was followed by horns erupting from the ground. The fortress’s west wall crumbled. The giant drove toward the weak point and Scribonia, then struck Hope with its glaive. Light flashed from the tree and burned its skin, but the blow had reached the very thing the company was there to protect.

Nienna rushed toward the breach, shouting for the attackers to stay away from the tree. Elenia kept casting through tears. Dale used healing magic for Adelia. Nienna’s own reserves were running low, and her attacks were doing too little. She began to cry, then changed her plan.

She enclosed Hope in a Wall of Force. Calling out that the brute would have to kill her to reach the tree, she flew away from it, glowing with purple celestial radiance. The brute turned toward her. Dale urged Adelia to abandon the Hallowing and protect their friends. Nienna refused: she would take the fight away; they must finish, then come and find her.

One last run

That tree is bigger than any of us! Please, let me run.......one last time.Nienna

Beyond the portal, Nienna could see glowing eyes beneath a dark hood and more creatures waiting. Then a wraith reached Adelia. She dropped to the ground amid flashing magic. Gartina and Elenia struggled, but held their concentration. Nienna bolted toward the opening and called goodbye to both of them, telling them to finish the job.

Her farewell to Dale reached toward a life she would not share: if he ever had a daughter, perhaps he could name her after her. Elenia called after Nienna that she still owed her a diamond. Dale shouted to forget the Hallowing and save their allies. The wraiths began turning to follow Nienna toward the Gate.

Nienna told Dale that Hope mattered more than any one of them and that she would live on in their hearts. She was trying to buy time for people who were still fighting and still casting. The spell had not yet succeeded. Gartina crackled with electricity, Elenia shone with light, and Adelia sent healing through the party’s shadows as the others tried to hold on.

On the other side

Nienna crossed through, then cast Dispel Magic on the portal from the far side. Beyond it lay nothingness and a horde of vile creatures. She wished she had stayed on the material side of the Gate. She faced them anyway.

Dale reached toward her with one more gift of bardic courage. Nienna told him to stay back. Jiangshi moved toward the portal too, wanting to save her; Elenia called for help. Nienna raised her hand and said goodbye to “sweet Dale.”

Fight on. This is not the end. See you in another life.Nienna

She turned to face the horde. Dale called her foolish and brave. Nienna’s decision left her beyond the Gate while the others remained with Hope. Her earlier death on the Plains of Trial and Elenia’s Raise Dead at the Tower had ended in a return; this was a separate loss, and nobody at the tree had secured another rescue.

Death at the closing Gate

A wordless, scraping sound carried a message to their souls: nobody would come to her aid. As the Gate closed, the figure called Death stood where Nienna had been. Light bent away from him and the air seemed to burn at his presence. He called their friend interesting and said he might keep her as a pet, adding that she would not last.

That threat was all the company received about what lay beyond. It did not let them witness Nienna’s further fate or verify what Death intended to do. The figure vanished. Dale rushed toward the place where the Gate had been, screaming.

Elenia returned her hand to Hope and kept casting, shaking and crying. Jiangshi joined in prayer and encouragement. Dale gathered his shield and spent his last spell on the tree. Jiangshi also collected Okasan’s bones. The surviving company had lost Nienna, the fortress was damaged, and the Hallowing still had to be finished.

The life she left them time to save

Many quiet hours followed. Those who were not casting took brief turns resting. The casters had no such relief. Saray returned in time to see the spell’s final moments. Through the remains of the tower came a warm, dry wind. The ground rumbled, and Hope pulsed with power.

Where a small, shriveled tree had pushed through toxic earth, a great burst of life spread in every direction. The Hallowing was complete. Adelia, Gartina and Elenia were exhausted after more than a day of sustaining the work and carrying one another through its interruptions.

Nienna had not known this ending when she ran. She made time for it, and the people at Hope used that time to finish what they had begun together. The restored life did not bring her back to stand beside them. It was the work she had told them to complete.

People and places in this history Nienna · Adelia & Hope · Gael · Elenia · Gartina · Dale · Jiangshi · Saray · Scribonia
